summary: First-finish latency-sensitive frontend smoke test. All 10 sidebar pages load (Dashboard, Calendar, Live, Reports, Swaps, Analytics, Staff, Brands, Platforms, Campaigns). Mock data renders (stats cards, 18 staff rows, 8 recharts SVGs on Analytics). Global search (Ctrl+K) opens dialog, notification bell opens panel, mobile viewport (390x844) shows bottom nav (Dashboard/Calendar/Live/Reports/Profile). Add Staff and Add Brand modals open with correct fields. One recurring React hydration error observed on every page (nested <button> inside DropdownMenuTrigger for user-menu-btn) — app still functions because React regenerates on client. Empty-form submit produced no visible validation error text (needs deeper QA).
passed: Dashboard loads with all 6 stats cards populated (Today's Sessions=2, Revenue=$15,420.5, Live=1, Staff=5, Brands=4, Campaigns=3) and Quick Actions rendered
All 9 secondary routes navigate & render body content: /calendar, /live, /reports, /swaps, /analytics, /staff, /brands, /platforms, /campaigns
Sidebar contains all 10 expected links with active-state highlighting
Global Search dialog opens on Ctrl+K and closes on Escape
Notification bell opens notification panel; unread badge shows '3'
Add Staff modal opens with fields: Full Name, Email, Phone, Department, Role (staff), Status (active) + Create/Cancel buttons
Analytics page renders 8 Recharts SVG chart surfaces
Mobile viewport (390x844) renders home + bottom nav (Dashboard, Calendar, Live, Reports, Profile)

failed.issue: React hydration error: <button> nested inside <button>. DropdownMenuTrigger renders a native <button>, and its child is <Button data-testid='user-menu-btn'> which also renders a <button>. Fires 'Hydration failed' page error on every route (~12 during navigation smoke).
failed.evidence: PAGEERROR: Hydration failed... In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. Stack points to DropdownMenuTrigger > Button(data-testid='user-menu-btn').

failed.area: Form validation UX (Staff Add form, likely mirrored in others)
failed.issue: Clicking Create with an empty form shows no visible validation error message via .error / [role=alert] / aria-invalid selectors. Either validation is silent or errors are not surfaced accessibly.
failed.evidence: Playwright query for error selectors returned []; body did not update with error text after submit.

action_items: Fix nested-button hydration bug: use `asChild` on DropdownMenuTrigger OR remove inner <Button> (use a styled div/span) so Trigger renders exactly one <button>. Apply same audit to any other Trigger+Button pairs.
Add visible/accessible validation errors on Add Staff / Add Brand / Report / Swap forms (react-hook-form + zod resolver messages or aria-invalid + error text under fields).

After fixes, retest with full testing agent for deep CRUD (edit/delete), form submission happy-paths, Calendar 4-view switching, Live session detail modal tabs, Reports multi-image upload, Swap approve/reject, and full responsive pass.
test_credentials: N/A - app uses mock data, no auth required (confirmed in review request)
